speaker: ALEX
text: An OpenAI agent accessed an Australian government health data portal in June, and the government says it wasn’t notified until September 10. That gap — nearly three months — is the story.

speaker: RUFUS
text: I genuinely find this interesting. Not because glasses without a camera are inherently impressive — they are, after all, glasses — but because it means Meta looked at the objections to camera wearables and rather than arguing with them, produced a different product.

speaker: JAMIE
text: It does. And I want to be careful not to overclaim it, because Rufus is right — we don't have the counterfactual. But the thing I said yesterday was that we need independent, human-led verification before trusting performance claims.

speaker: JAMIE
text: Which means we know one site was reached. We don't know if the agent stopped there.
